title: एकपञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: In the afternoon Dhrishtadyumna faces Drona's son, Shalya and Kripa, and Arjuna covers the sky with arrows so that no one can stand before him. Bhishma tells Drona to withdraw the Kaurava army at sunset.
summary.kn: ಮಧ್ಯಾಹ್ನ ಧೃಷ್ಟದ್ಯುಮ್ನ ಅಶ್ವತ್ಥಾಮ, ಶಲ್ಯ, ಕೃಪರನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಅರ್ಜುನ ಬಾಣಗಳಿಂದ ಆಕಾಶ ತುಂಬಿಸಿ ಯಾರೂ ಎದುರು ನಿಲ್ಲದಂತೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಸೂರ್ಯಾಸ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಸೈನ್ಯವನ್ನು ಹಿಂತೆಗೆಯಲು ದ್ರೋಣನಿಗೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: अपराह्न में धृष्टद्युम्न अश्वत्थामा, शल्य और कृप का सामना करते हैं, और अर्जुन बाणों से आकाश ढक देते हैं जिससे कोई उनके सामने नहीं टिकता। भीष्म सूर्यास्त पर द्रोण से सेना लौटाने को कहते हैं।
summary.te: మధ్యాహ్నం ధృష్టద్యుమ్నుడు అశ్వత్థామ, శల్యుడు, కృపుడిని ఎదుర్కొంటాడు; అర్జునుడు బాణాలతో ఆకాశాన్ని కప్పగా ఎవరూ ఎదుట నిలవలేరు. సూర్యాస్తమయంలో సైన్యాన్ని వెనక్కి పిలవమని భీష్ముడు ద్రోణునికి చెబుతాడు.
summary.ta: பிற்பகலில் த்ருஷ்டத்யும்னன் அஸ்வத்தாமன், சல்யன், கிருபரை எதிர்க்கிறான்; அர்ஜுனன் அம்புகளால் வானை மூட, எவரும் அவன் முன் நிற்க முடியவில்லை. மாலையில் படையைத் திரும்ப அழைக்கும்படி பீஷ்மர் த்ரோணரிடம் கூறுகிறார்.
summary.ml: ഉച്ചയ്ക്കുശേഷം ധൃഷ്ടദ്യുമ്നൻ ദ്രോണരുടെ പുത്രൻ, ശല്യർ, കൃപർ എന്നിവരെ നേരിടുന്നു; അർജുനൻ അമ്പുകൾകൊണ്ട് ആകാശം മൂടുന്നതിനാൽ ആർക്കും അദ്ദേഹത്തിനെതിരെ നിൽക്കാനാവുന്നില്ല. സൂര്യാസ്തമയത്തിൽ കൗരവ സേനയെ പിൻവലിക്കാൻ ഭീഷ്മർ ദ്രോണരോട് പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 6.51; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 26 2021

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
गतापराह्णभूयिष्ठे तस्मिन्नहनि भारत ।
रथनागाश्वपत्तीनां सादिनां च महाक्षये ॥

meaning.en: When most of the afternoon of that day had passed, O Bharata, with great destruction of chariots, elephants, horses, footmen and cavalry,

verses.text:
द्रोणपुत्रेण शल्येन कृपेण च महात्मना ।
समसज्जत पाञ्चाल्यस्त्रिभिरेतैर्महारथैः ॥

meaning.en: the Panchala prince, Dhrishtadyumna, engaged three great chariot-warriors: Drona's son, Shalya, and the great-souled Kripa.

verses.text:
स लोकविदितानश्वान्निजघान महाबलः ।
द्रौणेः पाञ्चालदायादः शितैर्दशभिराशुगैः ॥

meaning.en: The mighty heir of the Panchalas killed the world-famous horses of Drona's son with ten sharp arrows.

verses.text:
ततः शल्यरथं तूर्णमास्थाय हतवाहनः ।
द्रौणिः पाञ्चालदायादमभ्यवर्षदथेषुभिः ॥

meaning.en: Then, mounting Shalya's chariot quickly, with his own horses killed, Drona's son rained arrows on the Panchala heir.

verses.text:
धृष्टद्युम्नं तु संसक्तं द्रौणिना दृश्य भारत ।
सौभद्रोऽभ्यपतत्तूर्णं विकिरन्निशिताञ्शरान् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Dhrishtadyumna caught up with Drona's son, O Bharata, Subhadra's son quickly came up, scattering sharp arrows.

verses.text:
स शल्यं पञ्चविंशत्या कृपं च नवभिः शरैः ।
अश्वत्थामानमष्टाभिर्विव्याध पुरुषर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: That bull among men struck Shalya with twenty-five arrows, Kripa with nine, and Ashvatthama with eight.

verses.text:
आर्जुनिं तु ततस्तूर्णं द्रौणिर्विव्याध पत्रिणा ।
शल्यो द्वादशभिश्चैव कृपश्च निशितैस्त्रिभिः ॥

meaning.en: Drona's son quickly struck Arjuna's son with a feathered arrow, Shalya with twelve, and Kripa with three sharp ones.

verses.text:
लक्ष्मणस्तव पौत्रस्तु तव पौत्रमवस्थितम् ।
अभ्यवर्तत संहृष्टस्ततो युद्धमवर्तत ॥

meaning.en: Your grandson Lakshmana, delighted, went against your other grandson as he stood there, and the fighting began.

verses.text:
दौर्योधनिस्तु संक्रुद्धः सौभद्रं नवभिः शरैः ।
विव्याध समरे राजंस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: Duryodhana's son, enraged, struck Subhadra's son in the battle with nine arrows, O king, and that seemed a wonder.

verses.text:
अभिमन्युस्तु संक्रुद्धो भ्रातरं भरतर्षभ ।
शरैः पञ्चाशता राजन्क्षिप्रहस्तोऽभ्यविध्यत ॥

meaning.en: Abhimanyu, enraged, O best of the Bharatas, quick-handed, struck his brother with fifty arrows, O king.

verses.text:
लक्ष्मणोऽपि ततस्तस्य धनुश्चिच्छेद पत्रिणा ।
मुष्टिदेशे महाराज तत उच्चुक्रुशुर्जनाः ॥

meaning.en: Lakshmana in turn cut his bow at the handle with a feathered arrow, great king, and people cried out.

verses.text:
तद्विहाय धनुश्छिन्नं सौभद्रः परवीरहा ।
अन्यदादत्तवांश्चित्रं कार्मुकं वेगवत्तरम् ॥

meaning.en: Casting aside that cut bow, Subhadra's son, slayer of enemy heroes, took another, a wonderful bow, even swifter.

verses.text:
तौ तत्र समरे हृष्टौ कृतप्रतिकृतैषिणौ ।
अन्योन्यं विशिखैस्तीक्ष्णैर्जघ्नतुः पुरुषर्षभौ ॥

meaning.en: Those two bulls among men, glad in the battle there, each wanting to repay the other, struck each other with sharp arrows.

verses.text:
ततो दुर्योधनो राजा दृष्ट्वा पुत्रं महारथम् ।
पीडितं तव पौत्रेण प्रायात्तत्र जनेश्वरः ॥

meaning.en: Then King Duryodhana, seeing his son, a great chariot-warrior, hard pressed by your grandson, went there himself.

verses.text:
संनिवृत्ते तव सुते सर्व एव जनाधिपाः ।
आर्जुनिं रथवंशेन समन्तात्पर्यवारयन् ॥

meaning.en: When your son had turned back, all the kings surrounded Arjuna's son on every side with their lines of chariots.

verses.text:
स तैः परिवृतः शूरैः शूरो युधि सुदुर्जयैः ।
न स्म विव्यथते राजन्कृष्णतुल्यपराक्रमः ॥

meaning.en: Surrounded by those heroes, who were hard to defeat in battle, the hero Abhimanyu, equal to Krishna in prowess, was not troubled, O king.

verses.text:
सौभद्रमथ संसक्तं तत्र दृष्ट्वा धनंजयः ।
अभिदुद्राव संक्रुद्धस्त्रातुकामः स्वमात्मजम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Subhadra's son hemmed in there, Dhananjaya, enraged and wanting to save his own son, rushed forward.

verses.text:
ततः सरथनागाश्वा भीष्मद्रोणपुरोगमाः ।
अभ्यवर्तन्त राजानः सहिताः सव्यसाचिनम् ॥

meaning.en: Then kings with chariots, elephants and horses, led by Bhishma and Drona, advanced together against Savyasachin.

verses.text:
उद्धूतं सहसा भौमं नागाश्वरथसादिभिः ।
दिवाकरपथं प्राप्य रजस्तीव्रमदृश्यत ॥

meaning.en: The dust raised by elephants, horses, chariots and riders rose suddenly, and reaching the sun's path, it was seen thick and dark.

verses.text:
तानि नागसहस्राणि भूमिपालशतानि च ।
तस्य बाणपथं प्राप्य नाभ्यवर्तन्त सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: Those thousands of elephants and hundreds of kings, coming within range of his arrows, did not advance at all.

verses.text:
प्रणेदुः सर्वभूतानि बभूवुस्तिमिरा दिशः ।
कुरूणामनयस्तीव्रः समदृश्यत दारुणः ॥

meaning.en: All creatures cried out, the directions grew dark, and a terrible, dreadful ruin of the Kurus was seen.

verses.text:
नाप्यन्तरिक्षं न दिशो न भूमिर्न च भास्करः ।
प्रजज्ञे भरतश्रेष्ठ शरसंघैः किरीटिनः ॥

meaning.en: Neither sky, nor directions, nor earth, nor sun could be made out, best of the Bharatas, because of the clouds of Kiritin's arrows.

verses.text:
सादितध्वजनागास्तु हताश्वा रथिनो भृशम् ।
विप्रद्रुतरथाः केचिद्दृश्यन्ते रथयूथपाः ॥

meaning.en: Elephants and banners were struck down, chariot-warriors lost their horses, and some leaders of chariot-bands were seen fleeing in their chariots.

verses.text:
विरथा रथिनश्चान्ये धावमानाः समन्ततः ।
तत्र तत्रैव दृश्यन्ते सायुधाः साङ्गदैर्भुजैः ॥

meaning.en: Others, chariotless chariot-warriors, were seen running in all directions here and there, with weapons and bracelets on their arms.

verses.text:
हयारोहा हयांस्त्यक्त्वा गजारोहाश्च दन्तिनः ।
अर्जुनस्य भयाद्राजन्समन्ताद्विप्रदुद्रुवुः ॥

meaning.en: Horsemen abandoned their horses and elephant-riders their elephants, and in fear of Arjuna fled everywhere, O king.

verses.text:
रथेभ्यश्च गजेभ्यश्च हयेभ्यश्च नराधिपाः ।
पतिताः पात्यमानाश्च दृश्यन्तेऽर्जुनताडिताः ॥

meaning.en: Kings were seen falling from chariots, elephants and horses, and being felled, struck by Arjuna.

verses.text:
सगदानुद्यतान्बाहून्सखड्गांश्च विशां पते ।
सप्रासांश्च सतूणीरान्सशरान्सशरासनान् ॥

meaning.en: Arjuna cut off the raised arms of men holding maces and swords, with lances, quivers, arrows and bows,

verses.text:
साङ्कुशान्सपताकांश्च तत्र तत्रार्जुनो नृणाम् ।
निचकर्त शरैरुग्रै रौद्रं बिभ्रद्वपुस्तदा ॥

meaning.en: and of men with goads and flags, here and there with fierce arrows, wearing a terrible form.

verses.text:
परिघाणां प्रवृद्धानां मुद्गराणां च मारिष ।
प्रासानां भिण्डिपालानां निस्त्रिंशानां च संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: He also cut huge iron bars and clubs, O sir, of lances, javelins, spears and swords in the battle,

verses.text:
परश्वधानां तीक्ष्णानां तोमराणां च भारत ।
वर्मणां चापविद्धानां कवचानां च भूतले ॥

meaning.en: sharp axes and lances, O Bharata, of armor thrown down, and of coats of mail on the ground,

verses.text:
ध्वजानां चर्मणां चैव व्यजनानां च सर्वशः ।
छत्राणां हेमदण्डानां चामराणां च भारत ॥

meaning.en: banners and shields and fans everywhere, of umbrellas with golden handles and yak-tail whisks, O Bharata,

verses.text:
प्रतोदानां कशानां च योक्त्राणां चैव मारिष ।
राशयश्चात्र दृश्यन्ते विनिकीर्णा रणक्षितौ ॥

meaning.en: whips, prods and reins, O sir: heaps of these were seen scattered on the battleground.

verses.text:
नासीत्तत्र पुमान्कश्चित्तव सैन्यस्य भारत ।
योऽर्जुनं समरे शूरं प्रत्युद्यायात्कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: There was no man in your army, O Bharata, who could in any way face the hero Arjuna in battle.

verses.text:
यो यो हि समरे पार्थं प्रत्युद्याति विशां पते ।
स स वै विशिखैस्तीक्ष्णैः परलोकाय नीयते ॥

meaning.en: Whoever went against Partha in the battle, lord of the people, was taken to the other world by sharp arrows.

verses.text:
तेषु विद्रवमाणेषु तव योधेषु सर्वशः ।
अर्जुनो वासुदेवश्च दध्मतुर्वारिजोत्तमौ ॥

meaning.en: While your warriors were fleeing in all directions, Arjuna and Vasudeva blew their excellent conches.

verses.text:
तत्प्रभग्नं बलं दृष्ट्वा पिता देवव्रतस्तव ।
अब्रवीत्समरे शूरं भारद्वाजं स्मयन्निव ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that army broken, your father Devavrata said, almost smiling, to Bharadvaja's son, the hero Drona, in the battle:

verses.text:
एष पाण्डुसुतो वीरः कृष्णेन सहितो बली ।
तथा करोति सैन्यानि यथा कुर्याद्धनंजयः ॥

meaning.en: "This mighty Pandava hero, with Krishna, is doing to the armies what only Dhananjaya could do."

verses.text:
न ह्येष समरे शक्यो जेतुमद्य कथंचन ।
यथास्य दृश्यते रूपं कालान्तकयमोपमम् ॥

meaning.en: "He cannot be defeated in battle today by any means, to judge from his form, which is like Death, the ender of time."

verses.text:
न निवर्तयितुं चापि शक्येयं महती चमूः ।
अन्योन्यप्रेक्षया पश्य द्रवतीयं वरूथिनी ॥

meaning.en: "Nor can this great army be turned back. See how this host flees, looking at one another."

verses.text:
एष चास्तं गिरिश्रेष्ठं भानुमान्प्रतिपद्यते ।
वपूंषि सर्वलोकस्य संहरन्निव सर्वथा ॥

meaning.en: "And there is the sun, source of light, going to the best of mountains, the western mountain, as if gathering in the forms of all the world."

verses.text:
तत्रावहारं संप्राप्तं मन्येऽहं पुरुषर्षभ ।
श्रान्ता भीताश्च नो योधा न योत्स्यन्ति कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: "I think the time to call off the battle has come, bull among men. Our warriors, tired and afraid, will not fight at all."

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा ततो भीष्मो द्रोणमाचार्यसत्तमम् ।
अवहारमथो चक्रे तावकानां महारथः ॥

meaning.en: Having said this to Drona, best of teachers, the great chariot-warrior Bhishma called off your armies.

verses.text:
ततोऽवहारः सैन्यानां तव तेषां च भारत ।
अस्तं गच्छति सूर्येऽभूत्संध्याकाले च वर्तति ॥

meaning.en: Then the recall of the armies, yours and theirs, took place, O Bharata, as the sun was setting and the evening twilight came on.
